wwo.name: Singapore

road_validity.basis: Guide map 1890 and Constable atlas 1893 reconstructed at opening date. Detailed core roads, partial mapped coverage, and an independently sourced open field.

wwo.method: 1890 guide-map alignment; selected street skeleton and water/open-ground exclusions. Parcels and all buildings reconstructed in sourced use polygons. Outside the polygons and in source gaps, no inference of absence. Revised lower river and Tanjong Pagar harbour layout from the 1893 city atlas, with mapped work sheds and separate wet/dry coverage. Sourced open grounds and yard aprons precede placement; roof cover comes from the accepted footprints. Selected river approaches, crossings, mapped Chinatown street blocks and local coverage use the same 1893 reference frame as the mapped riverbanks. Keppel Harbour shoreline, wharf sheds and Keppel frontage trace Admiralty chart 2023. Kallang and Rochore rivers, crossing and basin are traced in the 1890 plan frame and corroborated by the 1891 census. The Kallang and lower town coastline traces terminate at separately mapped limits. The Keppel turn reaches only the segment readable in the 1890 source. The west-bank street ends follow the same guide-map shoreline, and ground approaches stop landward of the drawn coast.

shore_registration.limits: Controls surround the lower river; Tanjong Pagar is an extrapolation. Coast and shed outlines are traced from the atlas, with positional uncertainty. Tanjong Pagar Land Co. property limit did not establish dry land.

dock_registration.limits: Separate registration from the town atlas. The charted north harbour extends from Pasir Panjang to the eastern works. The link to the town atlas beyond the north sheet edge is an inferred shoreline around separately registered traces. The Borneo Wharf stone label lies near the position predicted by the printed coordinates; its exact marker centre could not be isolated. Modern datum and tie to the town atlas are approximate. Structure heights and road widths inferred. Tidal mud flats depict high-water coverage. The printed under-construction seawall is excluded.

kallang_registration.limits: Reuses the published 1890 registration (118 m leave-one-out RMS, 174 m maximum). 1891 map cross-checks topology, not coordinate residuals. No measurement of tidal level, bridge deck construction, or individual building outline. 1890 guide map and 1891 Admiralty chart remain independently registered at Keppel.
